# opnsense_hostdiscovery_settings (Resource)

Host discovery settings (**Interfaces ▸ Neighbors ▸ Automatic discovery**): the hostwatch service records the hosts seen on the interfaces. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `hostdiscovery_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_hostdiscovery_settings.this
  id = "hostdiscovery_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_hostdiscovery_settings" "this" {
  enabled       = true
  skip_networks = ["10.0.50.0/24"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable host discovery (hostwatch), which records the hosts seen on the interfaces.
- `expire4_interval` (Number) Seconds before an IPv4 host is forgotten (3600 or more). `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `expire6_interval` (Number) Seconds before an IPv6 host is forgotten (3600 or more). `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces to watch, empty for all.
- `promiscuous` (Boolean) Capture in promiscuous mode.
- `skip_networks` (Set of String) Networks that are not recorded.
- `verbose` (Boolean) Verbose logging.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `hostdiscovery_settings`.
